integrity.proof: Residue-tail normal form, additive-closure inequalities, fixed-F parameter polygons, arithmetic sums.
integrity.verification: Standard-library enumeration of every numerical semigroup at F=4..18 and separate parameter and coefficient checks to F=750.

scientific_limitations: Only the prescribed pair {3,F} and F>=4 is treated; the P={3} boundary has an extra semigroup.
No claim that the quasipolynomial period 18 is minimal.
Historical priority is qualified by other potential descriptions of three-periodic ideal tails.
title: Complete genus census for the covariety \(\mathcal C(\{3,F\})\)
